title: Copilot cloud agent sessions failed after routing change
source_note: Public GitHub status report summarizing a routing change that removed ingress for the Copilot Cloud Agent session API.

deployment_timeline.event: configuration change applied to session routing
change reverted and ingress path restored
full recovery verified

traces.description: ingress route missing for Copilot Cloud Agent sessions

blast_radius.summary: Copilot Cloud Agent session creation and remote session viewing were unavailable for a subset of users.
blast_radius.user_impact: session starts failed or returned errors

root_cause: A configuration change to network routing removed the ingress path for the session API.
remediation: Revert the routing change and improve deployment validation for network-facing configuration.

title: GitHub search degraded by load balancer saturation
source_note: Public GitHub status report describing load balancer saturation in front of search infrastructure.

deployment_timeline.event: search latency began to climb
incident declared after saturation detected
mitigation applied by scaling and blocking traffic
incident resolved

traces.description: requests timing out in the load balancing tier

blast_radius.summary: Search-related functionality was intermittently unavailable across Issues, Pull Requests, Projects, Repositories, Actions, Package Registry, and Dependabot Alerts.

root_cause: Anonymous distributed scraping traffic saturated the load balancing tier in front of search infrastructure.
remediation: Scale the load balancer tier, block anomalous traffic, and tune connection handling.

title: AWS UAE region impaired by localized power issue
source_note: Public AWS Health Dashboard incident summary for the ME-CENTRAL-1 operational issue affecting multiple services.

deployment_timeline.event: localized power issue identified in a single AZ
traffic shifted away from impaired infrastructure
S3 and DynamoDB error rates elevated
recovery work continued and communications narrowed to affected customers

traces.description: instance launches failed in the impaired AZ
object retrieval errors increased for pre-existing data

blast_radius.summary: A single AZ failure cascaded into region-wide degradation for EC2, S3, DynamoDB, Lambda, CloudWatch, RDS, and the console/CLI.
blast_radius.user_impact: increased error rates, elevated latencies, and failed instance launches

root_cause: A localized power issue impaired one Availability Zone and propagated into dependent services.
remediation: Fail traffic away from the impaired AZ, restore power and connectivity, and recover affected resources from backups or alternate regions.
propagation_chain: dependent services recover only after foundational services

title: Cloudflare tunnel and browser isolation sessions churned during edge restarts
source_note: Public Cloudflare incident report describing internal service restarts across edge infrastructure leading to connection churn.

deployment_timeline.event: connectivity disruptions investigated
root cause identified as internal service restarts
fix monitored after recovery

traces.description: active tunnels reconnected simultaneously after edge restart

blast_radius.summary: Cloudflare Tunnel and Browser Isolation sessions were forced to reconnect, causing elevated error rates and registration failures.
blast_radius.user_impact: active sessions disconnected and new registrations failed

root_cause: Internal service restarts across edge infrastructure caused connection churn and simultaneous re-establishment.
remediation: Stabilize the underlying services and allow connection success rates to return to normal.

title: Stripe API latency and intermittent 5xx responses
source_note: Public Stripe status page used as the canonical source for current service health. The benchmark record captures a conservative operational replay case grounded in payment API degradation themes.

deployment_timeline.event: payments API latency began increasing
5xx errors observed for a subset of requests
service returned to normal after mitigation

blast_radius.summary: Payment authorization and checkout flows experienced elevated latency and intermittent failures.

root_cause: Operational degradation in a downstream payments dependency caused latency to cascade into intermittent 5xx responses.
remediation: Stabilize the downstream dependency, reduce retry pressure, and monitor checkout latency during recovery.

title: Redis managed service failover caused latency spikes
source_note: Public Redis status page used as the canonical source for service health. The benchmark record captures a conservative managed-cache failover scenario.

deployment_timeline.event: primary node became unstable
failover initiated to a standby node
latency returned to baseline after failover

traces.description: cache operations slowed while the cluster failed over

blast_radius.summary: Cache reads and writes slowed during managed-service failover, affecting applications dependent on Redis latency.
blast_radius.user_impact: applications saw cache timeouts and elevated latency

root_cause: A managed Redis primary became unstable and triggered a failover event.
remediation: Complete failover, validate replica health, and monitor latency until the cache returned to baseline.

title: Kubernetes control plane degraded during etcd pressure
source_note: Public Kubernetes status page used as the canonical source for service health. The benchmark record captures a conservative control-plane degradation case.

control-plane requests began timing out
pressure reduced and control plane recovered

traces.description: API server requests timed out under etcd pressure

blast_radius.summary: Cluster control-plane operations slowed, which risked delayed scheduling and management operations.
blast_radius.user_impact: management operations timed out or slowed
